name: PlanIt Event Manager
author: brelandr

sections.description:
PlanIt Event Manager is a feature-rich free plugin that lets you easily create and manage events on your site. With calendar views, comprehensive event management, and seamless integration, it’s the perfect solution for any website that needs to display events.

Upgrade to Premium for advanced features like Week View, Year View, Photo View, Map View, Recurring Events, Custom Fields, Event Series, Featured Events, CSV Import, and much more!

Visit https://landtechwebdesigns.com/planit-event-manager-premium to upgrade.

Free Version Features

  • Calendar Views: Day and Month views
  • List View: Display events in a clean chronological list
  • Event Management: Create, edit, and delete events with full details
  • Venues & Organizers: Manage venues and organizers separately
  • Event Categories & Tags: Organize events with categories and tags
  • Hide Past Events: Option to automatically hide past events
  • Google Maps Integration: Display venue locations on maps (requires API key)
  • iCal & Google Calendar Export: Export events to external calendars
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Widget Support: Upcoming events widget for sidebars
  • Shortcodes: Easy calendar and list embedding
  • Search & Filter: Find events easily
  • Featured Images: Add images to events

Premium Features (Available in Premium Version)

  • Week View – See your week at a glance
  • Year View – Annual overview
  • Photo View – Visual grid with event images
  • Map View – Interactive map with event locations
  • Recurring Events – Create repeating events automatically
  • Custom Fields – Add unlimited custom data to events
  • Event Series – Group related events together
  • Featured Events – Highlight important events
  • CSV Import – Bulk import events from spreadsheet
  • The Events Calendar Import – Migrate from other plugins
  • Event Cost/Price – Display event pricing
  • Event Website – Link to external event pages
  • Event Timezone – Per-event timezone support
  • RSS Feed – Events RSS feed
  • Advanced Widgets – Featured Events, Event Series, Countdown widgets

External services

This plugin makes use of the following third-party services:

Google Maps JavaScript API

What it is: Google Maps JavaScript API for displaying event locations.

Data sent: The user’s browser sends the site’s API key and the visitor’s IP address to Google when viewing a map.

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Events > Settings to configure the plugin
  4. Start creating events!
sections.faq:
What are the requirements?

WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.2 or higher. No external dependencies required.

How do I display the calendar?

Use the shortcode [twec_calendar] or visit the events archive page. You can specify the view: [twec_calendar view="month"]

Can I hide past events?

Yes! Go to Events > Settings and enable “Hide Past Events”.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Calendar views: Day and Month views (Week, Year, Photo, Map views available in Premium)
  • List view with pagination
  • Venue and organizer management
  • Event categories and tags
  • Google Maps integration (requires API key)
  • iCal and Google Calendar export
  • Widget support: Upcoming Events widget
  • Shortcodes: [twec_calendar] and [twec_list]
  • Hide past events option
  • Responsive design
  • Security: Proper nonce verification and capability checks
  • Security: All output properly escaped to prevent XSS
  • Performance: Optimized database queries for better performance
  • Performance: Efficient meta_query usage with DATE type comparisons
